name: desa-sukarama-monorepo
description: Website Resmi Desa Sukarama — Nuxt 4 + Fastify + Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: concurrently --names API,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck

author: Pemerintah Desa Sukarama
